text: Aura is my favorite habit tracker after trying quite a few. Among its many wins are clean design elements, customizable themes, easy task creation, a simple widget, and a sprinkling of small achievements along the way. These all combine to make me feel just rewarded enough to keep engaging without feeling like I have to centralize my life around the app.
author: Matt Knezevich

text: As a Premium user, I love the app! However, I’d like to suggest an improvement to the workflow: please add a built-in Pomodoro timer. Specifically, it would be great if the app could automatically fetch and log the time once the timer ends. Manually entering logs feels like an unnecessary step; an integrated timer would make the experience much more seamless.
